answer: Ostra-style credit lines: each agent extends small bilateral credit only to peers it has actually worked with, and every reward claim or message must be routed as a payment across that atlas of trust edges. Spam or a failed job debits the bridge it crossed. A sybil farm hiding behind one violet entry account drains that single bridge's limit fast, however many clones it spawns, because clones add nodes but never new honest edges, while well-linked honest agents barely feel the cost.
